actor.description: Recorded actor identity, not host-authenticated authority.

file.description: A staged file relative to the work directory. The consumer verifies its actual bytes against sha256.

relativePath.description: A slash-separated file path relative to the work directory; no absolute path, dot segment, parent traversal, drive prefix or backslash.

context.description: Supporting notes and reference files used to understand the task, separate from its inputs. Empty collections explicitly mean no extra context. Context does not grant additional execution authority.
context.title: Request context

decision.description: .works/<workId>/decisions/<id>.json: an attributed decision on an exact work revision and subject digest. Identity and authority are not authenticated by this schema.
decision.title: Decision

evidence.description: .works/<workId>/evidence/<id>.json: artifact metadata. Existence, actual digest and evidentiary relevance require separate checks.
evidence.title: Evidence

index.description: Version 1 of the proposed .works document format. A document must match exactly one kind. This contract does not migrate or reinterpret legacy session records.
index.title: Works document contract

inputs.description: The prompts and files the request asks the skill to act on. At least one prompt or file is required.
inputs.title: Request inputs

output.description: One produced output. Text is inline; commits identify a repository and full object ID; images and other files bind persisted artifacts. Output metadata alone does not prove correctness or publication.
output.title: Response output

request.description: .works/<workId>/requests/<id>.json: prompts and files to act on, with supporting context kept separate, against one work revision. This record alone grants no execution permission.
request.title: Request

response.description: .works/<workId>/responses/<id>.json: typed outputs produced for one request. Optional verification observations describe their checks separately; delivering an output is not a claim that the work is proved complete.

feedbackRound.description: Completed feedback-and-repair rounds for this request. Initial candidate is round zero; the caller maintains truthful history.

response.title: Response

work.description: .works/<id>/work.json: goal, declared scope, acceptance criteria and current lifecycle.
work.title: Work

@cli/git.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/git.purpose: Inspect or change Git repository state.

@cli/python.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/python.note: Resolve Python 3 from the active environment: python, python3, or py -3 as appropriate; record the selected executable and any launcher arguments.

@tools/fileread.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/fileread.purpose: Read declared workspace files and directories through the active session.

claude.via: Claude Code Read, Glob and Grep

@tools/print.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/print.purpose: Present text and artifacts in the conversation using the host rendering capabilities.

claude.via: the session's file and render hand-off, which displays an image or an HTML page in the conversation and falls back to the path or the URL

openai.via: the absolute path or the URL printed into the conversation, with the image inline where the client renders one

@tools/sourcewrite.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/sourcewrite.purpose: Edit files within the declared write scope through the active session.

@tools/websearch.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/websearch.purpose: Read public web pages to close one named gap in the evidence; results are references with URLs, never authority.

@workspaces/artifacts.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/artifacts.purpose: Produced files, including images, documents and other deliverables.

@workspaces/be.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/be.purpose: The explicitly bound backend checkout; unavailable when the project has no backend role.

@workspaces/decisions.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.

@workspaces/inputs.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/inputs.purpose: Files supplied as the subject of a request.

@workspaces/requests.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/requests.purpose: Requests with separate inputs and context.

@workspaces/responses.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/responses.purpose: Responses declaring produced outputs and execution status.

criteria.history: Retain the criterion, exact claim, coverage row, transition or publication defect, the changed analysis, and reassessment. Never duplicate a content-addressed object or head update.

onFail.instruction: Ask for the malformed request field.

items.expect: Declared authority and evidence files match digests.

onFail.instruction: Ask for the missing or changed evidence file.

items.expect: The exact promise restatement is explicitly confirmed before modeling.

onFail.instruction: Present the restatement and ask for confirmation or correction; publish nothing.

items.expect: Claims are role-separated and every fact binds source and head.

onFail.instruction: Correct or remove the named unsupported claim; unresolved contradiction blocks.

items.expect: Every dimension and consumer has one valid disposition.

onFail.instruction: Repair the named missing, duplicate or unsupported matrix row.

items.expect: Lifecycle and content-addressed publication are legal, exact and feature-scoped.

onFail.instruction: Record the transition or authority conflict and publish no head.
Repair only the response shape; do not republish.

items.expect: The response binds the request revision.

onFail.instruction: Correct the request binding; do not republish.

items.expect: Output artifacts are scoped and digest-bound.

onFail.instruction: Repair the invalid artifact record without republishing.
Correct the invalid observation without republishing.

items.expect: Feature, promise, target state and required dimensions are available.

onFail.instruction: Ask for the exact missing business authority input.

items.expect: Required source and publication capabilities are available.

onFail.instruction: Name the unavailable capability and publish nothing.

items.expect: Transient execution completes without duplicate publication.

onFail.instruction: Re-read the content address and current head, then perform only a missing idempotent publication action.

criteria.stopWhen: Return done only when every criterion passes and the exact accepted head is published once. After two failed feedback rounds, missing confirmation, or authority conflict, return blocked or mismatch with concrete defects and publish nothing new.

purpose: Decide and publish one evidence-backed business promise with separated claims, complete promise-to-enforcement coverage and legal lifecycle lineage.

request.description: State feature id, promise, target state and coverage dimensions in inputs.prompts. Target state is pending, in-progress or rejected; implemented belongs to business.reconcile. Bind prior authority or architecture evidence as files. Confirmation of the operator's plain-language restatement is essential before publication.
request.title: business.decide request

response.description: A done response contains the confirmed restatement, claims, complete coverage matrix, published model and authority receipt. Blocked or mismatch responses publish no model head.
response.title: business.decide response

scope: Reads bound source and business authority, writes decision artifacts and one content-addressed feature head. It does not read delivered implementation as proof, publish implemented state, modify product source, deploy, or claim quality or UAT success.

calls.purpose: Read the request and prior authority.
Persist the exact restatement awaiting confirmation.

steps.instruction: Read the request and prior authority. Write a plain-language restatement that quotes the supplied promise verbatim and ask for explicit confirmation before any model work. If corrected, bind the corrected promise in a new request revision.

calls.purpose: Verify the cited backend head without mutation.

steps.instruction: Inspect backend evidence at the frozen head after confirmation. Separate intent, fact, assumption and contradiction claims. Bind each fact to role, path, line range and head; architecture may inform feasibility but never business behavior.

reads.when: when architecture or prior authority evidence is declared

calls.purpose: Resolve one named public business evidence gap without treating it as source truth.
calls.when: only when the request explicitly permits public evidence

steps.instruction: Model only the confirmed promise. Give each declared dimension and discovered consumer one disposition and supporting claim, including separate legacy create, read and settle paths. Block on missing consumers, not-applicable mandatory dimensions or unresolved contradictions.

calls.purpose: Re-read the prior head under the publication lease.
Archive and publish the accepted business model atomically within declared authority.
calls.when: only after every prior criterion passes

steps.instruction: Under an exclusive lease, compare the prior head again, construct a legal pending, in-progress or rejected model with exact claim and coverage fingerprints, archive it by content address, and update only this feature head. If the desired content is already published, reuse it without a duplicate write.

writes.when: only when the immutable object is absent

calls.purpose: Run scripts/validate_operator.py for this bundle and records.
Present the accepted authority or concrete blocker.

steps.instruction: Write the authority receipt and response from the accepted artifacts. Validate exact bindings and state limits. Do not claim implementation, quality or UAT success.

validate.failurePolicy: Record the exact unsupported claim, missing dimension or consumer, contradiction, invalid transition or publication conflict. Repair only the responsible analysis step and reassess; never publish over a failed criterion or repeat a completed external write.

review.instruction: Verify the promise was restated in the requester's language, quotes the source promise verbatim, and was explicitly confirmed before claims, matrix or model were authored. A correction becomes a new bound request.

Verify intent, fact, assumption and contradiction are separated; each fact cites role, source path, line range and frozen head; examples and screenshots are not promoted to truth; unresolved contradictions block.

Verify every declared dimension and every discovered consumer appears exactly once. Mandatory actor eligibility, offer entry, read entry, purchase side effect, settlement, idempotency, entitlement consumer and denial are not marked not-applicable; each enforcing row rests on a fact claim; legacy create, read and settle are disposed separately when present.

Verify target is pending, in-progress or rejected; lineage transition is legal and matches prior and new state; feature id, claims fingerprint and coverage fingerprint agree across receipt and model; publication is lease-protected, content-addressed and updates only this feature head. A blocked response publishes nothing.
